title: Comment thread with replies
when: The user wants a comments section under content, with a form to post and replies one level deep.
prompt:
Goal: A readable thread with safe rendering of user text, a labeled form, and reply flows that keep focus in place.
Steps:
1. <section aria-labelledby="comments-title"> with an h2 Comments (12) and an <ol> of <li><article>: author, <time datetime>, body and a Reply button.
2. Replies nest in an <ol> inside the parent item, at most two levels; deeper replies show Replying to Ana.
3. The form: <label for> on the name input and the textarea, a <button type="submit">Post comment</button>, required fields.
4. New comments are built with createElement and textContent, with white-space: pre-line to keep line breaks.
5. Reply opens the same form under the comment and focuses the textarea; Cancel returns focus to Reply.
6. Without a backend, keep comments in localStorage inside try and catch and say they stay on this device.
Quality bar:
- Author and time are scannable above the text.
- Long threads keep readable line length.
- Posting shows the comment at once.
Pitfalls:
- Rendering comment text with innerHTML.
- Unlimited nesting that squeezes text on phones.
- Pretending to publish without a backend.
Verify:
- [ ] Form fields have labels and the form has a submit button.
- [ ] User text is inserted with textContent.
- [ ] Reply and Cancel move focus as described.
- [ ] Storage access is guarded.
Output: The comments section markup, comments.css and comments.js.

examples.input: secao de comentarios com respostas no blog
examples.output: ol of comment articles with Reply, nested replies one level, labeled form Post comment, textContent rendering
